Q1.en: For any two positive integers, the product of the numbers equals the product of their HCF and LCM. So \(a \times b = 5 \times 200 = 1000\), which is the choice 1000.
Q1.hi: किन्हीं दो धनात्मक पूर्णांकों का गुणनफल उनके HCF और LCM के गुणनफल के बराबर होता है। अतः \(a \times b = 5 \times 200 = 1000\), जो विकल्प 1000 है।

Q2.en: \(\sqrt{3}\) is irrational, and the product of a non-zero rational number and an irrational number is irrational. So \(4\sqrt{3}\) is irrational, which is the choice Irrational.
Q2.hi: \(\sqrt{3}\) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है, और किसी शून्येतर परिमेय संख्या तथा अपरिमेय संख्या का गुणनफल अपरिमेय होता है। अतः \(4\sqrt{3}\) अपरिमेय है, जो विकल्प अपरिमेय है।

Q3.en: The product of two numbers equals HCF \(\times\) LCM. So \(\text{HCF} = \frac{20 \times 25}{100} = \frac{500}{100} = 5\), which is the choice 5.
Q3.hi: दो संख्याओं का गुणनफल HCF \(\times\) LCM के बराबर होता है। अतः \(\text{HCF} = \frac{20 \times 25}{100} = \frac{500}{100} = 5\), जो विकल्प 5 है।

Q4.en: Cross-multiplying, \(x^2 + 6 = 10\), so \(x^2 = 4\) and \(x = \pm 2\), which is the choice \(\pm 2\).

Q5.en: The roots are equal when the discriminant is zero: \(b^2 - 4ac = (-8)^2 - 4 \times 2 \times c = 64 - 8c = 0\). So \(c = 8\), which is the choice 8.
Q5.hi: मूल बराबर होने के लिए विविक्तकर शून्य होना चाहिए: \(b^2 - 4ac = (-8)^2 - 4 \times 2 \times c = 64 - 8c = 0\). अतः \(c = 8\), जो विकल्प 8 है।

Q6.en: Since 2 is a zero of the polynomial, its value at \(x = 2\) is 0: \(2^2 - 3 \times 2 + 5a = 0\), that is \(4 - 6 + 5a = 0\). So \(5a = 2\) and \(a = \frac{2}{5}\), which is the choice \(\frac{2}{5}\).

Q7.en: Splitting the middle term, \(x^2 - 5x + 6 = x^2 - 2x - 3x + 6 = (x - 2)(x - 3)\). So the zeroes are 2 and 3, which is the choice \(2, 3\).
Q7.hi: मध्य पद को विभक्त करने पर \(x^2 - 5x + 6 = x^2 - 2x - 3x + 6 = (x - 2)(x - 3)\). अतः शून्यक 2 और 3 हैं, जो विकल्प \(2, 3\) है।

Q8.en: The \(x\)-coordinate of \((-5, 6)\) is negative and its \(y\)-coordinate is positive, so the point lies in the second quadrant, which is the choice Second quadrant.
Q8.hi: बिन्दु \((-5, 6)\) का \(x\)-निर्देशांक (भुज) ऋणात्मक तथा \(y\)-निर्देशांक (कोटि) धनात्मक है, अतः यह बिन्दु द्वितीय चतुर्थांश में स्थित है, जो विकल्प द्वितीय चतुर्थांश है।

Q9.en: The circumference of the circle is \(2\pi a\), and an arc subtending \(\theta\) at the centre is the fraction \(\frac{\theta}{360}\) of it. So the length of the arc is \(2\pi a \times \frac{\theta}{360}\), which is the choice \(2\pi a \times \frac{\theta}{360}\).
Q9.hi: वृत्त की परिधि \(2\pi a\) है, और केन्द्र पर \(\theta\) कोण अंतरित करने वाला चाप परिधि का \(\frac{\theta}{360}\) भाग होता है। अतः चाप की लंबाई \(2\pi a \times \frac{\theta}{360}\) है, जो विकल्प \(2\pi a \times \frac{\theta}{360}\) है।

Q10.en: In similar triangles corresponding angles are equal, so \(\angle B = \angle E = 56^\circ\). By the angle sum property, \(\angle C = 180^\circ - 45^\circ - 56^\circ = 79^\circ\), which is the choice \(79^\circ\).
Q10.hi: समरूप त्रिभुजों के संगत कोण बराबर होते हैं, अतः \(\angle B = \angle E = 56^\circ\). त्रिभुज के कोणों के योग गुण से \(\angle C = 180^\circ - 45^\circ - 56^\circ = 79^\circ\), जो विकल्प \(79^\circ\) है।

Q11.en: For the acute angle \(A\), \(\sin A = \sqrt{1 - \cos^2 A} = \sqrt{1 - \frac{25}{169}} = \sqrt{\frac{144}{169}} = \frac{12}{13}\). So \(\tan A = \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} = \frac{12/13}{5/13} = \frac{12}{5}\), which is the choice \(\frac{12}{5}\).

Q12.en: \(\cos\theta = 1\) gives \(\theta = 0^\circ\), so \(\tan\theta = \tan 0^\circ = 0\), which is the choice 0.
Q12.hi: \(\cos\theta = 1\) से \(\theta = 0^\circ\) प्राप्त होता है, अतः \(\tan\theta = \tan 0^\circ = 0\), जो विकल्प 0 है।

Q14.en: \(\tan\alpha = \sin\alpha\) means \(\frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha} = \sin\alpha\), so either \(\sin\alpha = 0\) or \(\cos\alpha = 1\). Both give \(\alpha = 0^\circ\) (at \(90^\circ\), \(\tan\alpha\) is not defined). Check: \(\tan 0^\circ = 0 = \sin 0^\circ\). So \(\alpha = 0^\circ\), which is the choice \(0^\circ\).
Q14.hi: \(\tan\alpha = \sin\alpha\) का अर्थ है \(\frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha} = \sin\alpha\), अतः या तो \(\sin\alpha = 0\) या \(\cos\alpha = 1\). दोनों से \(\alpha = 0^\circ\) प्राप्त होता है (\(90^\circ\) पर \(\tan\alpha\) परिभाषित नहीं है)। जाँच: \(\tan 0^\circ = 0 = \sin 0^\circ\). अतः \(\alpha = 0^\circ\), जो विकल्प \(0^\circ\) है।

Q15.en: Area of a sector \(= \frac{\theta}{360} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60}{360} \times \pi \times 6^2 = \frac{1}{6} \times 36\pi = 6\pi\) cm\(^2\), which is the choice \(6\pi\) cm\(^2\).
Q15.hi: त्रिज्यखण्ड का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\theta}{360} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60}{360} \times \pi \times 6^2 = \frac{1}{6} \times 36\pi = 6\pi\) सेमी\(^2\), जो विकल्प \(6\pi\) सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q16.en: Joining the two cubes gives a cuboid of length \(2a\), breadth \(a\) and height \(a\). Its surface area is \(2(2a \times a + a \times a + a \times 2a) = 2 \times 5a^2 = 10a^2\) cm\(^2\) (the two cubes have \(12a^2\), less the two joined faces \(2a^2\)). This is the choice \(10a^2\) cm\(^2\).
Q16.hi: दोनों घनों को मिलाने पर लंबाई \(2a\), चौड़ाई \(a\) और ऊँचाई \(a\) का एक घनाभ बनता है। इसका पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(2(2a \times a + a \times a + a \times 2a) = 2 \times 5a^2 = 10a^2\) सेमी\(^2\) है (दोनों घनों का \(12a^2\), जिसमें से मिले हुए दो फलक \(2a^2\) घट जाते हैं)। यह विकल्प \(10a^2\) सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q17.en: The class marks are 5, 15, 25, 35. \(\sum f_i x_i = 4 \times 5 + 5 \times 15 + 4 \times 25 + 7 \times 35 = 20 + 75 + 100 + 245 = 440\) and \(\sum f_i = 20\). Mean \(= \frac{440}{20} = 22\), which is the choice 22.

Q18.en: \(n = 4 + 6 + 10 + 6 + 4 = 30\), so \(\frac{n}{2} = 15\). The cumulative frequencies are 4, 10, 20, 26, 30; the first one greater than 15 is 20, belonging to the class 10-15. So the median class is 10-15, which is the choice 10-15.

Q19.en: A leap year has 366 days, that is 52 complete weeks and 2 extra days. The 52 weeks give 52 Sundays. The 2 extra days can be (Sun, Mon), (Mon, Tue), (Tue, Wed), (Wed, Thu), (Thu, Fri), (Fri, Sat), (Sat, Sun): 7 equally likely outcomes, of which 2 contain a Sunday. So the probability of 53 Sundays is \(\frac{2}{7}\), which is the choice \(\frac{2}{7}\).
Q19.hi: अधिवर्ष में 366 दिन होते हैं, अर्थात् 52 पूरे सप्ताह और 2 अतिरिक्त दिन। 52 सप्ताहों में 52 रविवार होते हैं। 2 अतिरिक्त दिन (रवि, सोम), (सोम, मंगल), (मंगल, बुध), (बुध, गुरु), (गुरु, शुक्र), (शुक्र, शनि), (शनि, रवि) हो सकते हैं: ये 7 समसंभावी परिणाम हैं, जिनमें से 2 में रविवार है। अतः 53 रविवार होने की प्रायिकता \(\frac{2}{7}\) है, जो विकल्प \(\frac{2}{7}\) है।

Q20.en: An event that is certain to occur is a sure event, and the probability of a sure event is 1, which is the choice 1.
Q20.hi: जो घटना निश्चित रूप से घटती है वह निश्चित घटना कहलाती है, और निश्चित घटना की प्रायिकता 1 होती है, जो विकल्प 1 है।

B1a.en:
Suppose, on the contrary, that \(4 - 3\sqrt{2}\) is rational. Then we can write \(4 - 3\sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{q}\), where \(p\) and \(q\) are integers and \(q \neq 0\).
So \(3\sqrt{2} = 4 - \frac{p}{q} = \frac{4q - p}{q}\), that is \(\sqrt{2} = \frac{4q - p}{3q}\).
Since \(p\) and \(q\) are integers, \(\frac{4q - p}{3q}\) is rational, so \(\sqrt{2}\) would be rational.
But \(\sqrt{2}\) is irrational. This contradiction arises from our wrong assumption that \(4 - 3\sqrt{2}\) is rational.
Hence \(4 - 3\sqrt{2}\) is an irrational number. Hence proved.
B1a.hi:
इसके विपरीत, मान लीजिए कि \(4 - 3\sqrt{2}\) एक परिमेय संख्या है। तब \(4 - 3\sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{q}\) लिखा जा सकता है, जहाँ \(p\) और \(q\) पूर्णांक हैं तथा \(q \neq 0\).
अतः \(3\sqrt{2} = 4 - \frac{p}{q} = \frac{4q - p}{q}\), अर्थात् \(\sqrt{2} = \frac{4q - p}{3q}\).
चूँकि \(p\) और \(q\) पूर्णांक हैं, इसलिए \(\frac{4q - p}{3q}\) परिमेय है, अतः \(\sqrt{2}\) भी परिमेय होगा।
परन्तु \(\sqrt{2}\) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है। यह विरोधाभास हमारी इस गलत कल्पना के कारण उत्पन्न हुआ कि \(4 - 3\sqrt{2}\) परिमेय है।
अतः \(4 - 3\sqrt{2}\) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है। इति सिद्धम्।

B1b.en:
The distance of a point \((x, y)\) from the origin \((0, 0)\) is \(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}\).
So the required distance \(= \sqrt{36^2 + 15^2} = \sqrt{1296 + 225} = \sqrt{1521} = 39\).
The distance of the point \((36, 15)\) from the origin is 39 units.

B1c.en:
By the section formula, the point dividing the join of \((x_1, y_1)\) and \((x_2, y_2)\) in the ratio \(m_1 : m_2\) is \(\left(\frac{m_1 x_2 + m_2 x_1}{m_1 + m_2}, \frac{m_1 y_2 + m_2 y_1}{m_1 + m_2}\right)\).
Here \((x_1, y_1) = (-1, 7)\), \((x_2, y_2) = (4, -3)\), \(m_1 = 2\), \(m_2 = 3\).
\(x = \frac{2 \times 4 + 3 \times (-1)}{2 + 3} = \frac{8 - 3}{5} = 1\)
\(y = \frac{2 \times (-3) + 3 \times 7}{2 + 3} = \frac{-6 + 21}{5} = 3\)
So the required point is \((1, 3)\).

B1d.en:
Take \(\Delta ABC\), right-angled at \(B\). By the Pythagoras theorem, \(AB^2 + BC^2 = AC^2\).
Dividing each term by \(AB^2\): \(\frac{AB^2}{AB^2} + \frac{BC^2}{AB^2} = \frac{AC^2}{AB^2}\), that is \(1 + \left(\frac{BC}{AB}\right)^2 = \left(\frac{AC}{AB}\right)^2\).
In this triangle \(\tan A = \frac{BC}{AB}\) and \(\sec A = \frac{AC}{AB}\).
So \(1 + \tan^2 A = \sec^2 A\). This holds for \(0^\circ \le A < 90^\circ\) (at \(A = 0^\circ\) both sides equal 1). Hence proved.
B1d.hi:
\(\Delta ABC\) लीजिए जिसमें \(B\) पर समकोण है। पाइथागोरस प्रमेय से \(AB^2 + BC^2 = AC^2\).
प्रत्येक पद को \(AB^2\) से भाग देने पर: \(\frac{AB^2}{AB^2} + \frac{BC^2}{AB^2} = \frac{AC^2}{AB^2}\), अर्थात् \(1 + \left(\frac{BC}{AB}\right)^2 = \left(\frac{AC}{AB}\right)^2\).
इस त्रिभुज में \(\tan A = \frac{BC}{AB}\) तथा \(\sec A = \frac{AC}{AB}\).
अतः \(1 + \tan^2 A = \sec^2 A\). यह \(0^\circ \le A < 90^\circ\) के लिए सत्य है (\(A = 0^\circ\) पर दोनों पक्ष 1 के बराबर हैं)। इति सिद्धम्।

B1e.en:
Radius of the cone and of the hemisphere \(r = 3.5\) cm. Height of the hemisphere \(= r = 3.5\) cm, so height of the cone \(h = 15.5 - 3.5 = 12\) cm.
Volume of the cone \(= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5 \times 12 = 154\) cm\(^3\).
Volume of the hemisphere \(= \frac{2}{3}\pi r^3 = \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5 \times 3.5 = 89.83\) cm\(^3\) (approx.).
Volume of the toy \(= 154 + 89.83 = 243.83\) cm\(^3\) (approx.).
B1e.hi:
शंकु तथा अर्धगोले की त्रिज्या \(r = 3.5\) सेमी। अर्धगोले की ऊँचाई \(= r = 3.5\) सेमी, अतः शंकु की ऊँचाई \(h = 15.5 - 3.5 = 12\) सेमी।
शंकु का आयतन \(= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5 \times 12 = 154\) सेमी\(^3\).
अर्धगोले का आयतन \(= \frac{2}{3}\pi r^3 = \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5 \times 3.5 = 89.83\) सेमी\(^3\) (लगभग)।
खिलौने का आयतन \(= 154 + 89.83 = 243.83\) सेमी\(^3\) (लगभग)।

B1f.en:
The highest frequency is 8, so the modal class is 3-5.
Here \(l = 3\), \(h = 2\), \(f_1 = 8\), \(f_0 = 7\) (class before), \(f_2 = 2\) (class after).
Mode \(= l + \left(\frac{f_1 - f_0}{2f_1 - f_0 - f_2}\right) \times h = 3 + \frac{8 - 7}{16 - 7 - 2} \times 2 = 3 + \frac{2}{7} = 3.286\).
So the mode of the data is about 3.29 (family members).
B1f.hi:
सबसे अधिक बारंबारता 8 है, अतः बहुलक वर्ग 3-5 है।
यहाँ \(l = 3\), \(h = 2\), \(f_1 = 8\), \(f_0 = 7\) (पहले वाले वर्ग की बारंबारता), \(f_2 = 2\) (बाद वाले वर्ग की बारंबारता)।
बहुलक \(= l + \left(\frac{f_1 - f_0}{2f_1 - f_0 - f_2}\right) \times h = 3 + \frac{8 - 7}{16 - 7 - 2} \times 2 = 3 + \frac{2}{7} = 3.286\).
अतः आँकड़ों का बहुलक लगभग 3.29 (परिवार के सदस्य) है।

B2a.en:
Splitting the middle term: \(3x^2 - x - 4 = 3x^2 - 4x + 3x - 4 = x(3x - 4) + 1(3x - 4) = (3x - 4)(x + 1)\).
The polynomial is zero when \(3x - 4 = 0\) or \(x + 1 = 0\), so the zeros are \(\alpha = \frac{4}{3}\) and \(\beta = -1\).
Verification (here \(a = 3\), \(b = -1\), \(c = -4\)):
Sum of zeros \(= \frac{4}{3} + (-1) = \frac{1}{3}\), and \(-\frac{b}{a} = -\frac{(-1)}{3} = \frac{1}{3}\).
Product of zeros \(= \frac{4}{3} \times (-1) = -\frac{4}{3}\), and \(\frac{c}{a} = \frac{-4}{3} = -\frac{4}{3}\).
So sum of zeros \(= -\frac{\text{coefficient of } x}{\text{coefficient of } x^2}\) and product of zeros \(= \frac{\text{constant term}}{\text{coefficient of } x^2}\). The relationship is verified.

B2b.en:
Let one number be \(x\). Since the sum is 27, the other number is \(27 - x\).
Their product is 182: \(x(27 - x) = 182\), so \(27x - x^2 = 182\), that is \(x^2 - 27x + 182 = 0\).
Splitting the middle term (\(13 \times 14 = 182\), \(13 + 14 = 27\)): \(x^2 - 13x - 14x + 182 = 0\), so \(x(x - 13) - 14(x - 13) = 0\), that is \((x - 13)(x - 14) = 0\).
So \(x = 13\) or \(x = 14\). If \(x = 13\), the other number is \(27 - 13 = 14\); if \(x = 14\), the other is 13.
The required numbers are 13 and 14. (Check: \(13 + 14 = 27\), \(13 \times 14 = 182\).)

B2c.en:
Given: a circle with centre \(O\) and a tangent \(XY\) to it at the point \(P\).
To prove: \(OP \perp XY\).
Proof: Take any point \(Q\) on \(XY\) other than \(P\) and join \(OQ\).
The point \(Q\) must lie outside the circle: if it lay on or inside the circle, \(XY\) would meet the circle at two points and would be a secant, not a tangent.
Let \(OQ\) meet the circle at the point \(R\). Then \(OQ = OR + RQ > OR\). But \(OR = OP\) (radii of the same circle), so \(OQ > OP\).
This is true for every point \(Q\) of \(XY\) other than \(P\). So \(OP\) is the shortest of all the distances from \(O\) to the points of \(XY\).
Of all the line segments that can be drawn from a point to a line, the perpendicular is the shortest. Therefore \(OP \perp XY\).
Thus the tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact. Hence proved.
B2c.hi:
दिया है: केन्द्र \(O\) वाला एक वृत्त तथा बिन्दु \(P\) पर इसकी स्पर्श रेखा \(XY\).
सिद्ध करना है: \(OP \perp XY\).
उपपत्ति: \(XY\) पर \(P\) के अतिरिक्त कोई बिन्दु \(Q\) लीजिए और \(OQ\) को मिलाइए।
बिन्दु \(Q\) वृत्त के बाहर ही होगा: यदि यह वृत्त पर या वृत्त के अन्दर होता, तो \(XY\) वृत्त को दो बिन्दुओं पर काटती और स्पर्श रेखा न होकर छेदक रेखा होती।
माना \(OQ\) वृत्त को बिन्दु \(R\) पर काटती है। तब \(OQ = OR + RQ > OR\). परन्तु \(OR = OP\) (एक ही वृत्त की त्रिज्यायें), अतः \(OQ > OP\).
यह \(XY\) के \(P\) के अतिरिक्त प्रत्येक बिन्दु \(Q\) के लिए सत्य है। अतः \(O\) से \(XY\) के बिन्दुओं तक की सभी दूरियों में \(OP\) सबसे छोटी है।
किसी बिन्दु से किसी रेखा पर खींचे गये सभी रेखाखण्डों में लम्ब सबसे छोटा होता है। अतः \(OP \perp XY\).
इस प्रकार वृत्त के किसी बिन्दु पर स्पर्श रेखा, स्पर्श बिन्दु से जाने वाली त्रिज्या पर लम्ब होती है। इति सिद्धम्।

B2d.en:
Given: \(\Delta ABC\) and \(\Delta DEF\) in which \(\angle A = \angle D\), \(\angle B = \angle E\) and \(\angle C = \angle F\).
To prove: \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{AC}{DF} = \frac{BC}{EF}\), and hence \(\Delta ABC \sim \Delta DEF\).
Construction: Cut \(DP = AB\) on \(DE\) and \(DQ = AC\) on \(DF\), and join \(PQ\).
Proof: In \(\Delta ABC\) and \(\Delta DPQ\): \(AB = DP\), \(\angle A = \angle D\) and \(AC = DQ\). So \(\Delta ABC \cong \Delta DPQ\) (SAS congruence rule).
Hence \(\angle B = \angle DPQ\) (CPCT). But \(\angle B = \angle E\) (given), so \(\angle DPQ = \angle E\).
These are corresponding angles made by the transversal \(DE\) with the lines \(PQ\) and \(EF\), so \(PQ \parallel EF\).
In \(\Delta DEF\), by the Basic Proportionality Theorem, \(\frac{DP}{PE} = \frac{DQ}{QF}\), so \(\frac{PE}{DP} = \frac{QF}{DQ}\).
Adding 1 to both sides: \(\frac{DP + PE}{DP} = \frac{DQ + QF}{DQ}\), that is \(\frac{DE}{DP} = \frac{DF}{DQ}\), so \(\frac{DP}{DE} = \frac{DQ}{DF}\).
Since \(DP = AB\) and \(DQ = AC\): \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{AC}{DF}\).
In the same way, cutting \(EM = BA\) on \(ED\) and \(EN = BC\) on \(EF\) and joining \(MN\), we get \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{BC}{EF}\).
So \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{AC}{DF} = \frac{BC}{EF}\): the corresponding sides are in the same ratio. As the corresponding angles are also equal, \(\Delta ABC \sim \Delta DEF\). Hence proved.
B2d.hi:
दिया है: \(\Delta ABC\) तथा \(\Delta DEF\) जिनमें \(\angle A = \angle D\), \(\angle B = \angle E\) और \(\angle C = \angle F\).
सिद्ध करना है: \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{AC}{DF} = \frac{BC}{EF}\), और इसलिए \(\Delta ABC \sim \Delta DEF\).
रचना: \(DE\) पर \(DP = AB\) तथा \(DF\) पर \(DQ = AC\) काटिए और \(PQ\) को मिलाइए।
उपपत्ति: \(\Delta ABC\) और \(\Delta DPQ\) में: \(AB = DP\), \(\angle A = \angle D\) तथा \(AC = DQ\). अतः \(\Delta ABC \cong \Delta DPQ\) (SAS सर्वांगसमता नियम)।
इसलिए \(\angle B = \angle DPQ\) (सर्वांगसम त्रिभुजों के संगत भाग)। परन्तु \(\angle B = \angle E\) (दिया है), अतः \(\angle DPQ = \angle E\).
ये तिर्यक रेखा \(DE\) द्वारा रेखाओं \(PQ\) और \(EF\) के साथ बने संगत कोण हैं, अतः \(PQ \parallel EF\).
\(\Delta DEF\) में आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय से \(\frac{DP}{PE} = \frac{DQ}{QF}\), अतः \(\frac{PE}{DP} = \frac{QF}{DQ}\).
दोनों पक्षों में 1 जोड़ने पर: \(\frac{DP + PE}{DP} = \frac{DQ + QF}{DQ}\), अर्थात् \(\frac{DE}{DP} = \frac{DF}{DQ}\), अतः \(\frac{DP}{DE} = \frac{DQ}{DF}\).
चूँकि \(DP = AB\) तथा \(DQ = AC\): \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{AC}{DF}\).
इसी प्रकार \(ED\) पर \(EM = BA\) तथा \(EF\) पर \(EN = BC\) काटकर और \(MN\) को मिलाकर \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{BC}{EF}\) प्राप्त होता है।
अतः \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{AC}{DF} = \frac{BC}{EF}\): संगत भुजायें एक ही अनुपात में हैं। संगत कोण भी बराबर हैं, इसलिए \(\Delta ABC \sim \Delta DEF\). इति सिद्धम्।

B2e.en:
Make the cumulative frequency table:

| Weight (in kg) | Number of students (\(f\)) | Cumulative frequency (\(cf\)) |
|---|---|---|
| 40-45 | 2 | 2 |
| 45-50 | 3 | 5 |
| 50-55 | 8 | 13 |
| 55-60 | 6 | 19 |
| 60-65 | 6 | 25 |
| 65-70 | 3 | 28 |
| 70-75 | 2 | 30 |

Here \(n = 30\), so \(\frac{n}{2} = 15\). The first cumulative frequency greater than 15 is 19, so the median class is 55-60.
So \(l = 55\), \(cf = 13\) (of the class before), \(f = 6\), \(h = 5\).
Median \(= l + \left(\frac{\frac{n}{2} - cf}{f}\right) \times h = 55 + \frac{15 - 13}{6} \times 5 = 55 + \frac{10}{6} = 55 + 1.67 = 56.67\).
The median weight of the students is 56.67 kg.

B2f.en:
Total number of marbles \(= 5 + 8 + 4 = 17\), so there are 17 equally likely outcomes.
(i) Red marbles are 5, so P(red) \(= \frac{5}{17}\).
(ii) White marbles are 8, so P(white) \(= \frac{8}{17}\).
(iii) Marbles that are not green \(= 5 + 8 = 13\), so P(not green) \(= \frac{13}{17}\). (Equivalently, P(green) \(= \frac{4}{17}\) and \(1 - \frac{4}{17} = \frac{13}{17}\).)

B3a.en:
Given \(a_n = 3 + 2n\).
\(a_1 = 3 + 2 \times 1 = 5\), \(a_2 = 3 + 2 \times 2 = 7\), \(a_3 = 3 + 2 \times 3 = 9\).
Also \(a_{n+1} - a_n = [3 + 2(n + 1)] - [3 + 2n] = 2\), a constant, so the list is an AP with first term \(a = 5\) and common difference \(d = 2\).
The 24th term: \(a_{24} = 3 + 2 \times 24 = 51\).
Sum of the first \(n\) terms: \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a + l)\), where \(l\) is the last term.
\(S_{24} = \frac{24}{2}(5 + 51) = 12 \times 56 = 672\).
(Check with \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a + (n - 1)d] = 12[10 + 23 \times 2] = 12 \times 56 = 672\).)
So the sum of the first 24 terms is 672.

B3b.en:
Let the tens digit be \(x\) and the units digit be \(y\). Then the number is \(10x + y\), and the number with the digits reversed is \(10y + x\).
Their sum is 66: \((10x + y) + (10y + x) = 66\), so \(11x + 11y = 66\), that is
\(x + y = 6\) ... (1)
The digits differ by 2, so either \(x - y = 2\) ... (2) or \(y - x = 2\) ... (3).
Case 1: Adding (1) and (2): \(2x = 8\), so \(x = 4\) and \(y = 6 - 4 = 2\). The number is 42.
Case 2: Adding (1) and (3): \(2y = 8\), so \(y = 4\) and \(x = 6 - 4 = 2\). The number is 24.
Check: \(42 + 24 = 66\) and \(4 - 2 = 2\).
So the required number is 42 or 24.

B4a.en:
Let the tree break at the point \(P\), with \(Q\) its foot, and let the top touch the ground at the point \(R\). Then \(PQ\) is the standing part, \(PR\) is the broken part, \(\angle PQR = 90^\circ\), \(\angle PRQ = 30^\circ\) and \(QR = 8\) m.
In right \(\Delta PQR\):
\(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{PQ}{QR}\), so \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{PQ}{8}\) and \(PQ = \frac{8}{\sqrt{3}}\) m.
\(\cos 30^\circ = \frac{QR}{PR}\), so \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{8}{PR}\) and \(PR = \frac{16}{\sqrt{3}}\) m.
Height of the tree \(= PQ + PR = \frac{8}{\sqrt{3}} + \frac{16}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{24}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{24\sqrt{3}}{3} = 8\sqrt{3}\) m.
Taking \(\sqrt{3} = 1.732\), the height of the tree is \(8 \times 1.732 = 13.86\) m (approx.).
B4a.hi:
माना पेड़ बिन्दु \(P\) पर टूटता है, \(Q\) उसका पाद है, और उसका शिखर जमीन को बिन्दु \(R\) पर छूता है। तब \(PQ\) खड़ा भाग है, \(PR\) टूटा हुआ भाग है, \(\angle PQR = 90^\circ\), \(\angle PRQ = 30^\circ\) तथा \(QR = 8\) मीटर।
समकोण \(\Delta PQR\) में:
\(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{PQ}{QR}\), अतः \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{PQ}{8}\) और \(PQ = \frac{8}{\sqrt{3}}\) मीटर।
\(\cos 30^\circ = \frac{QR}{PR}\), अतः \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{8}{PR}\) और \(PR = \frac{16}{\sqrt{3}}\) मीटर।
पेड़ की ऊँचाई \(= PQ + PR = \frac{8}{\sqrt{3}} + \frac{16}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{24}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{24\sqrt{3}}{3} = 8\sqrt{3}\) मीटर।
\(\sqrt{3} = 1.732\) लेने पर पेड़ की ऊँचाई \(8 \times 1.732 = 13.86\) मीटर (लगभग) है।

B4b.en:
Let \(PQ\) be the building, with \(PQ = 7\) m, and \(RS\) the cable tower, with \(R\) its top and \(S\) its foot. Draw \(PM \perp RS\), so \(PM\) is horizontal and \(MS = PQ = 7\) m, \(PM = QS\).
The angle of depression of \(S\) from \(P\) is \(45^\circ\), so \(\angle PSQ = 45^\circ\) (alternate angles).
In right \(\Delta PQS\): \(\tan 45^\circ = \frac{PQ}{QS}\), so \(1 = \frac{7}{QS}\) and \(QS = 7\) m. Hence \(PM = 7\) m.
The angle of elevation of \(R\) from \(P\) is \(60^\circ\), so \(\angle RPM = 60^\circ\).
In right \(\Delta PMR\): \(\tan 60^\circ = \frac{RM}{PM}\), so \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{RM}{7}\) and \(RM = 7\sqrt{3}\) m.
Height of the tower \(RS = RM + MS = 7\sqrt{3} + 7 = 7(\sqrt{3} + 1)\) m.
Taking \(\sqrt{3} = 1.732\), the height is \(7 \times 2.732 = 19.12\) m (approx.).
B4b.hi:
माना \(PQ\) भवन है जिसकी ऊँचाई \(PQ = 7\) मीटर है, और \(RS\) केबल टावर है, जिसका शिखर \(R\) तथा पाद \(S\) है। \(PM \perp RS\) खींचिए, तब \(PM\) क्षैतिज है, \(MS = PQ = 7\) मीटर तथा \(PM = QS\).
\(P\) से \(S\) का अवनमन कोण \(45^\circ\) है, अतः \(\angle PSQ = 45^\circ\) (एकान्तर कोण)।
समकोण \(\Delta PQS\) में: \(\tan 45^\circ = \frac{PQ}{QS}\), अतः \(1 = \frac{7}{QS}\) और \(QS = 7\) मीटर। अतः \(PM = 7\) मीटर।
\(P\) से \(R\) का उन्नयन कोण \(60^\circ\) है, अतः \(\angle RPM = 60^\circ\).
समकोण \(\Delta PMR\) में: \(\tan 60^\circ = \frac{RM}{PM}\), अतः \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{RM}{7}\) और \(RM = 7\sqrt{3}\) मीटर।
टावर की ऊँचाई \(RS = RM + MS = 7\sqrt{3} + 7 = 7(\sqrt{3} + 1)\) मीटर।
\(\sqrt{3} = 1.732\) लेने पर ऊँचाई \(7 \times 2.732 = 19.12\) मीटर (लगभग) है।

B5a.en:
The hemisphere rests on a face of the cube, a square of side 7 cm, so its diameter can be at most the side of the cube.
Greatest diameter of the hemisphere \(= 7\) cm, so its radius \(r = 3.5\) cm.
Surface area of the solid \(=\) surface area of the cube \(-\) area of the base of the hemisphere \(+\) curved surface area of the hemisphere
\(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)
\(= 6 \times 7^2 + \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5\)
\(= 294 + 38.5 = 332.5\) cm\(^2\).
So the greatest diameter is 7 cm and the surface area of the solid is 332.5 cm\(^2\).
B5a.hi:
अर्द्धगोला घन के एक फलक पर टिका है, जो 7 सेमी भुजा का वर्ग है, अतः इसका व्यास अधिक से अधिक घन की भुजा के बराबर हो सकता है।
अर्द्धगोले का अधिकतम व्यास \(= 7\) सेमी, अतः इसकी त्रिज्या \(r = 3.5\) सेमी।
ठोस का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(=\) घन का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(-\) अर्द्धगोले के आधार का क्षेत्रफल \(+\) अर्द्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल
\(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)
\(= 6 \times 7^2 + \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5\)
\(= 294 + 38.5 = 332.5\) सेमी\(^2\).
अतः अधिकतम व्यास 7 सेमी है और ठोस का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 332.5 सेमी\(^2\) है।

B5b.en:
Let \(O\) be the centre and \(PQ\) the chord, with \(r = 20\) cm and \(\angle POQ = 60^\circ\). Take \(\pi = 3.14\) and \(\sqrt{3} = 1.73\).
Area of the sector \(OPQ = \frac{\theta}{360} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60}{360} \times 3.14 \times 20 \times 20 = \frac{1256}{6} = 209.33\) cm\(^2\) (approx.).
In \(\Delta OPQ\), \(OP = OQ = 20\) cm and \(\angle POQ = 60^\circ\), so the other two angles are also \(60^\circ\) and the triangle is equilateral.
Area of \(\Delta OPQ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 20^2 = 100\sqrt{3} = 100 \times 1.73 = 173\) cm\(^2\).
Area of the minor segment \(=\) area of the sector \(-\) area of \(\Delta OPQ = 209.33 - 173 = 36.33\) cm\(^2\).
Area of the circle \(= \pi r^2 = 3.14 \times 400 = 1256\) cm\(^2\).
Area of the major segment \(=\) area of the circle \(-\) area of the minor segment \(= 1256 - 36.33 = 1219.67\) cm\(^2\).
So the minor segment is 36.33 cm\(^2\) and the major segment is 1219.67 cm\(^2\) (exactly \(\left(\frac{200\pi}{3} - 100\sqrt{3}\right)\) cm\(^2\) and \(\left(\frac{1000\pi}{3} + 100\sqrt{3}\right)\) cm\(^2\)).
B5b.hi:
माना \(O\) केन्द्र तथा \(PQ\) जीवा है, जहाँ \(r = 20\) सेमी और \(\angle POQ = 60^\circ\). \(\pi = 3.14\) तथा \(\sqrt{3} = 1.73\) लीजिए।
त्रिज्यखण्ड \(OPQ\) का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\theta}{360} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60}{360} \times 3.14 \times 20 \times 20 = \frac{1256}{6} = 209.33\) सेमी\(^2\) (लगभग)।
\(\Delta OPQ\) में \(OP = OQ = 20\) सेमी तथा \(\angle POQ = 60^\circ\), अतः शेष दोनों कोण भी \(60^\circ\) हैं और त्रिभुज समबाहु है।
\(\Delta OPQ\) का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 20^2 = 100\sqrt{3} = 100 \times 1.73 = 173\) सेमी\(^2\).
लघु वृत्तखण्ड का क्षेत्रफल \(=\) त्रिज्यखण्ड का क्षेत्रफल \(-\) \(\Delta OPQ\) का क्षेत्रफल \(= 209.33 - 173 = 36.33\) सेमी\(^2\).
वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल \(= \pi r^2 = 3.14 \times 400 = 1256\) सेमी\(^2\).
दीर्घ वृत्तखण्ड का क्षेत्रफल \(=\) वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल \(-\) लघु वृत्तखण्ड का क्षेत्रफल \(= 1256 - 36.33 = 1219.67\) सेमी\(^2\).
अतः लघु वृत्तखण्ड का क्षेत्रफल 36.33 सेमी\(^2\) और दीर्घ वृत्तखण्ड का क्षेत्रफल 1219.67 सेमी\(^2\) है (यथार्थ रूप में \(\left(\frac{200\pi}{3} - 100\sqrt{3}\right)\) सेमी\(^2\) तथा \(\left(\frac{1000\pi}{3} + 100\sqrt{3}\right)\) सेमी\(^2\))।

doubts.B5b: The paper gives no value for pi or root 3; the solution takes pi = 3.14 and root 3 = 1.73 (NCERT's usual values for this question type) and also states the exact areas.
